rationale: Gen-3 adds exact Reed-Muller flat moves. The indicator of any affine flat of dimension k>=4 in F_2^n is a codeword of RM(n-k,n), a subset of RM(n-4,n), so taking the symmetric difference of P with a flat F preserves the linear, quadratic and cubic signature exactly. New T-count = m + |F| - 2|F∩P|. A flat is grown greedily: start from a parity (affine) or 0 (linear), and at each of dim=4/5 steps choose, from a random sample of parities p, the direction v=p^F[0] that maximises |(F+v)∩P|. So 3+1 strategic vectors span a 16-point flat; it cancels >=9 existing parities when positive. Positive flats are taken greedily, both inside the TODD chi_z-nullspace descent once shifts stall and at the top of the escape loop. Near-neutral flats (gain>=-4), neutral null kicks and -2 null kicks are scheduled adaptively by a bandit that reweights each kick operator by the record-breaking descents it causes. Locally (3 seeds, same 2.4M v3 budget, 0 fn_errors, 0 fallbacks): dev_diag 562.3 -> 552.3 and val_g3 710.7 -> 696.7 T per seed versus the G2-style escape search.
